name: astro-dev-cms
description: Astro Dev CMS — authoring shell for Astro content collections (dev-mode route)

scripts.check: tsc -p packages/routes && tsc -p packages/astro && tsc -p packages/crud && tsc -p packages/fields && bun run --filter @cms/form check && bun run --filter @cms/components check && bun run --filter @cms/authoring check
scripts.check:allowlist: bun test packages/crud/scripts/write-back-contract.test.ts && bun run packages/authoring/scripts/check-layer-boundaries.ts && bun test packages/authoring/scripts/authoring-deletion.test.ts packages/authoring/scripts/authoring-assets.test.ts packages/authoring/scripts/authoring-autosave.test.ts packages/authoring/scripts/authoring-session.test.ts
